name: Land Ho!
summary: At Faldir's Cove, the lookout Lolo greets you with news that Captain O'Breen's stop here will last far longer than planned. Two ships of the formation, the Spirit of Silverpine and the Maiden's Folly, are lost, and Lolo suggests you speak with the captain.

sections.title: Lolo's Welcome
sections.body: Lolo, ever on the lookout, spots you arriving at Faldir's Cove. Captain O'Breen had promised the crew only a few hours here, time enough to collect the treasure and head back to Booty Bay. Lolo doubts it will be so quick. Two ships of the formation, the Spirit of Silverpine and the Maiden's Folly, now rest on the bottom of the sea. Anyone who means to stay is told to talk to the captain.

sections.title: The Captain's Account
sections.body: Captain O'Breen calls the whole affair a horrible mess and fears Seahorn will take the ship if word gets out. One of the Professor's contraptions pointed to the lost treasure near the cove, so the Harbinger came in to dock and the two other ships were signaled to follow. Then the sea rumbled, the water drew back, and both ships crashed into the reef. It is not just a reef, the captain says, and something is down there. Help for the crew is promised a handsome payment.

faq.q: What happened to the other ships?
faq.answer: Two ships of the formation, the Spirit of Silverpine and the Maiden's Folly, were lost and lie on the bottom of the sea.

faq.q: Why did the crew come to Faldir's Cove?
faq.answer: Captain O'Breen came to gather treasure at the cove, expecting to stay only a few hours before heading back to Booty Bay.

faq.q: Who should you talk to at Faldir's Cove?
faq.answer: Lolo the lookout suggests you speak with Captain O'Breen in Faldir's Cove if you plan on sticking around.
